refnamediv.refpurpose: Delete a pointer that represent dt3.

varlistentry.listitem: : is a pointer representing dt3 to be deleted.

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: Given a pointer ptr of dt3, dt3_delete(ptr,"ptr") frees the memory hold by the pointer ptr and clears ptr in Scialb interpreter. If no parameters are given to dt3_delete(), then, all pointers of differents dt3 will be deleted.
